dedupe_keys.name: gtfs et visualisation du reseau ilevia

description: GTFS et Visualisation du réseau Ilévia is a dataset listed in Roubaix Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ilévia. Visualisation des lignes et arrêts de bus, métro, tram de la métropole. Retrouvez ici les arrêts et ici le GTFS (qui comprend également les horaires). Retrouvez également les horaires du réseau régional (arc en ciel) ici: GTFS Arc en Ciel. Coverage: Roubaix. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are itinéraire, bus, métro, Tramway. The portal shows 144 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roubaix-fr-portal.
